title: Data on Singaporeans Above 65 Who Have Registered LPA
what_it_is: Data on Singaporeans Above 65 Who Have Registered LPA

sections.label: Free LPA Form 1 applications
sections.summary: MSF will make Lasting Power of Attorney Form 1 applications free for all Singapore Citizens, even after the current fee waiver ends.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) is pleased to announce that we will make Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) Form 1 applications free of charge for all Singapore Citizens, even after the current fee waiver ends.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As of 20 February 2026, 404,000 or about one in seven Singapore Citizens have made an LPA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Amongst those aged above 65 years old, 197,000 or about one in four have done so.

sections.label: Public education and LPA support
sections.summary: MSF says it has consistently stepped up public education and awareness of LPA and will continue to do so, working with other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Besides reducing the cost barrier, some members of public, especially seniors who still find it difficult to understand what an LPA is and why it is important to make an LPA, can MSF do more in terms of stepping up public education and awareness of LPA, as well as perhaps making the process easier by having it in different languages and having more support to help seniors?

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We have been doing that consistently and we will continue to step up on it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We have been working very closely with various agencies, including the Agency for Integrated Care, the Central Provident Fund Board, the Ministry of Health.

sections.label: Simplifying LPA legal and medical terms
sections.summary: MSF is working to reach target audiences in different languages and to simplify legal and medical terms in the LPA process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: As the Member mentioned, we are also working on making sure that in terms of the languages, we are able to reach out to all our target audiences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Sometimes, in the LPA process, there can be some legal terms, medical terms, so we are trying to simplify those so that we are able to help make sure Singaporeans understand the importance and the urgency of making the LPA.

sections.label: Reasons a website is draggy
sections.summary: The passage states that if the website is draggy, there can be a few reasons why it may be so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: If the website is draggy, there can be a few reasons why it may be so.
